lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p29 - Listen and say.

details: Listen and say introduces the target digraphs 'ay' and 'oy'. Students listen to the audio and repeat the sounds to distinguish between the /eɪ/ and /ɔɪ/ phonemes.
Look for attentive listening and clear, confident repetition of the sounds 'ay' (as in day) and 'oy' (as in boy).

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p29 - Trace. Then write.

details: Trace and Write develops fine motor skills and letter formation. Students trace the digraphs to build muscle memory and then write them independently to reinforce the spelling pattern.
Look for correct pencil grip and neat formation of the letters 'a-y' and 'o-y', keeping the letters close together.

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p29 - Listen and match the sounds to the pictures.

details: Listen and match checks phonemic awareness. Students listen to the words (boy, play, day, toys) and draw a line connecting the picture to the correct sound bubble ('ay' or 'oy').
Look for logical connections: Boy/Toys -> 'oy'; Play/Day -> 'ay'.

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p73 - 3. Cut out and stick to make a sentence.

details: Cut out and stick develops sentence structure awareness. Students cut out the word cards from page 122 ("I", "go", "to", "school", "by", "bus") and paste them in the correct order in the boxes.
Look for the correct word order: "I go to school by bus."

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p29 - 5. Listen and read. Then trace.

details: Listen, read and trace combines auditory and kinesthetic learning. Students connect the spoken sentence "I go to school by car" to the written form, reinforcing sight words 'go' and 'by'.
Look for students following the text as they listen, accurate tracing of the sentence, and attempts to read along.
